pageSubtitle: Metrics 3–7 — Revenue, Gross Profit, High Margin Penetration, Repeat Order Rate, Customer Expansion

m3.tooltipInfo:
If the Avg line is far above Median, a few large customers are pushing the average up — not even growth. The orange bar + ⚠ marks a month where 1 customer contributed > 25% of total revenue. "High Margin Contribution" in the month detail measures the REVENUE share from High Margin products — different from M5, which measures the CUSTOMER share who bought them.

Formula: Avg Revenue = Total Existing Customer Revenue ÷ Number of Existing Customers.
Existing Customer = had transaction history before this period, and still transacted during this period.
m3.emptyMessage: No revenue data for this period
m3.topCustomersInfo: Sorted by highest revenue in the current period

m4.sectionLabel: Average Gross Profit per Existing Customer
m4.tooltipInfo:
Same as M3, but based on Gross Profit (absolute margin), not Revenue. Tiers are recalculated each month from the median individual GP — the customer mix per tier can differ from M3 even if the chart shape looks similar.

Formula: Avg Gross Profit = Total Gross Profit (Revenue − COGS) from Existing Customers ÷ Number of Existing Customers.
Existing Customer = had transaction history before this period, and still transacted during this period.
m4.topCustomersInfo: Sorted by highest GP in the current period

m5.tooltipInfo:
Measures the CUSTOMER share (not revenue) who bought at least 1 product tagged High Margin by an admin (Settings → High Margin). Different from M3's "High Margin Contribution", which measures the REVENUE share — many customers buying (M5 high) doesn't mean the value is large (M3 can still be low), or vice versa.

Formula: HM Penetration = (Existing Customers who bought ≥1 High Margin product ÷ Total Existing Customers) × 100%.
Existing Customer = had transaction history before this period, and still transacted during this period.
m5.emptyMessage: No existing customer bought high margin products this period
m5.topCustomersInfo: Sorted by highest high margin product revenue in the current period

m6.tooltipInfo:
"Repeat order" here means MORE THAN 1 transaction within the current month — not just having bought before. The green target line is configured in Settings → Threshold, not always 100%.

Formula: Repeat Order Rate = (Existing Customers with >1 transaction this period ÷ Total Existing Customers) × 100%.
Existing Customer = had transaction history before this period, and still transacted during this period.
m6.topCustomersInfo: Sorted by highest order count this period
m6.emptyMessage: No existing customer ordered more than once this period

m7.sectionLabel: Customer Expansion · Spending Up vs Down
m7.tooltipInfo:
Compared against the PREVIOUS period (same width, not the same month last year). A customer who didn't order at all before but orders now still counts as "spending up".

Formula: Expansion Rate = (Existing Customers with this period's revenue > previous period's revenue ÷ Total Existing Not-Yet-Dormant Customers) × 100%.
Population is existing customers who have NOT crossed the dormant threshold yet (same rule as M8, per division business category) — customers already confirmed dormant are excluded from the calculation entirely (that's M8's territory), not counted in the denominator. The "Inactive" category still shows, but only for customers who recently went quiet, not past the threshold yet.
m7.chartSubtitle: Green = spending up · Grey = flat/down/no transaction (total = 100%)
m7.emptyMessage: No expansion data for this period
